reproduced_defects.title: PREDICATE DECLARED TARGET CAN CONTRADICT ITS EXECUTABLE EVALUATOR
reproduced_defects.root_cause: StatePredicateDefinition validated state_class and input arity but nothing bound evaluator_kind to target_state; a declaration is DATA and the data could lie
reproduced_defects.reproducer: StatePredicateDefinition(target_state=INCREASING, evaluator_kind=CURRENT_LESS_THAN_PRIOR) bound to a ratified INCREASING rule; inputs prior=100, current=50; evaluator returns TRUE because 50 < 100
reproduced_defects.before_r3: INCREASING emitted for a falling series
reproduced_defects.after_r3: REFUSED at predicate construction (registration-time refusal as data, ValidationError wrapping PredicateRegistryError)
reproduced_defects.repair: closed semantic map EVALUATOR_TARGET_STATE: GREATER_THAN->INCREASING, LESS_THAN->DECREASING, EXACT_EQUALITY->UNCHANGED; no other pairing is legal; targets outside the map (all Class C states) are unconstructable

reproduced_defects.title: STATE RULE RATIFICATION BINDS ONLY predicate_ref NAME, NOT THE EXECUTABLE PREDICATE CONTENT
reproduced_defects.root_cause: StateRuleRegistry.ratify wrote a decision for (rule_id, version) without requiring the predicate to exist or recording any derivation context; semantics could be attached AFTER the operator decided
reproduced_defects.reproducer: register rule naming predicate:future@1; ratify (decision written); only afterwards register predicate:future@1
reproduced_defects.before_r3: ratification decision existed BEFORE the predicate; late registration made the rule usable
reproduced_defects.after_r3: ratification REFUSED ('ratification may not precede its predicate'); every wired decision records a full DerivationBinding and authorize live-verifies it
reproduced_defects.repair: predicate content fingerprint (PREDICATE_IDENTITY_BINDS_CONTENT); DerivationBinding records rule ref/version + predicate identity AND fingerprint + methodology identity AND fingerprint + required_measurement_refs; Phase 7: a low-level ledger entry without a binding is NOT usable authority; Phase 8: RATIFIED THEN != AUTHORITATIVE NOW if any bound component changed

reproduced_defects.title: EMITTED StateDimension CAN CLAIM A CALLER-SUPPLIED methodology_ref DIFFERENT FROM THE METHODOLOGY ACTUALLY USED
reproduced_defects.root_cause: emit_rule_gated_state resolved rule.methodology_ref for authorization but stored the independently caller-supplied methodology_ref argument on the emitted StateDimension
reproduced_defects.reproducer: rule.methodology_ref='book6-methodology@1'; caller passes methodology_ref='fake:other-methodology@9'; all rule/predicate checks pass
reproduced_defects.after_r3: REFUSED ('the derivation used one methodology and the output may not claim another'); the stored dimension always derives methodology_ref from the authorized rule
reproduced_defects.repair: DERIVATION USED METHODOLOGY A -> OUTPUT MAY NOT CLAIM METHODOLOGY B; caller argument retained only as an exact-equality cross-check; the dimension stores the canonical rule methodology

design_decisions.decision: Registration-time refusal for R3-D1 (data, not just emission-time refusal)
design_decisions.why: a lying predicate is invalid DATA; refusing it at construction means no rule can ever bind it, rather than every emission having to re-detect the lie

design_decisions.decision: Ratification-time derivation binding for R3-D2, with live replay at authorize (Phase 8)
design_decisions.why: the trust root is OPERATOR RATIFIED RULE + EXACT EXECUTABLE DERIVATION, not FIRST CALLER TO REGISTER predicate:x@1; binding at ratification makes the decision self-describing, and live verification makes REGISTERED THEN != AUTHORITATIVE NOW hold for derivation content

design_decisions.decision: Engine-owned wiring (Book6MeasurementRegistry owns the PredicateRegistry and wires state_rules to it)
design_decisions.why: Phase 7 without a bypass: on a wired registry there is no public path that writes a usable ratification decision without the full derivation binding; bare unwired registries remain for structural tests but record binding-less decisions that authorize() refuses

design_decisions.decision: Output provenance derived from the rule, argument kept as cross-check
design_decisions.why: API compatibility without authority leakage: the caller's string can no longer diverge from the derivation, and the stored value is the canonical rule methodology, never caller text

design_decisions.decision: Phase 16 dimension_id audit closed WITHOUT an R3-D4
design_decisions.why: dimension_id is a documented schema-local label; the derivation is fully identified on the dimension (rule, binding, methodology, measurement refs) and engine-built vectors bind dimension_id to the metric definition; no reproducer showed a forbidden misrepresentation, so no ontology project is started
